title: ATS error, v1 (draft)
description: Body of every non-2xx response from the ATS service. Clients branch on `code` and may show `message` to the user; neither contains internal details. Clients ignore properties they do not know. Draft: expect changes until both owners mark it stable.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Current codes: not-a-pdf (415), file-too-large (413), invalid-request (422), internal-error (500). New codes may be added within v1.

message.description: Plain-English explanation that can be shown to the user.
